note: 50 project facts and 50 questions that paraphrase them. Questions deliberately avoid reusing the fact's distinctive wording where a developer plausibly would, because that is the case keyword retrieval is expected to find hard.
facts: auth-tokens-expire-15-min
Access tokens expire after fifteen minutes; refresh tokens last thirty days.
password-hashing-argon2
Passwords are hashed with Argon2id, never bcrypt, since the 2025 migration.
rate-limit-at-gateway
Rate limiting is enforced at the API gateway, not in application code.
sessions-in-redis
User sessions live in Redis with a sliding expiry, not in Postgres.
orders-table-partitioned
The orders table is partitioned by month; queries without a date range scan everything.
soft-delete-everywhere
Records are never hard deleted; every table carries a removed_at column.
money-stored-in-paise
Monetary amounts are stored as integers in the smallest currency unit, never as floats.
timezone-is-utc
All timestamps are stored in UTC and converted only at the presentation layer.
webhook-retry-three-times
Outbound webhooks retry three times with exponential backoff, then land in a dead letter queue.
idempotency-key-required
Every write endpoint requires an Idempotency-Key header or returns 400.
search-uses-opensearch
Product search runs on OpenSearch; Postgres full text search was removed in 2024.
images-on-cloudfront
Product images are served from CloudFront with a one year cache header.
checkout-is-synchronous
Checkout is deliberately synchronous so inventory cannot oversell.
inventory-reserved-10-min
Inventory is reserved for ten minutes once checkout starts.
refunds-need-two-approvals
Refunds above fifty thousand require two approvers before processing.
gst-calculated-at-invoice
Tax is computed at invoice generation, never at cart time.
shipping-rates-cached-1h
Carrier shipping rates are cached for one hour per pincode.
pincode-service-is-flaky
The pincode lookup service times out roughly once per thousand calls; callers must handle it.
no-orm-in-reports
Reporting queries bypass the ORM and use raw SQL for performance.
migrations-are-forward-only
Database migrations are forward only; there are no down migrations.
staging-db-is-anonymised
The staging database is a nightly anonymised copy of production.
ci-runs-on-merge-queue
CI runs on a merge queue, so a green PR can still fail at merge time.
deploys-are-blue-green
Deployments are blue green with a ten minute soak before traffic shifts.
feature-flags-in-launchdarkly
Feature flags are managed externally and are not checked into the repository.
logs-retained-30-days
Application logs are retained for thirty days, then archived to cold storage.
pii-never-logged
Personally identifiable information must never reach application logs.
secrets-in-vault
Secrets come from the secret manager at boot; the repository holds only placeholder files.
api-versioned-in-path
The public API is versioned in the URL path, not by header.
graphql-is-internal-only
The GraphQL endpoint is for internal services only and is not exposed publicly.
grpc-between-services
Internal service to service calls use gRPC; HTTP is only for the edge.
events-on-kafka
Domain events are published to Kafka with at-least-once delivery.
consumers-must-be-idempotent
Event consumers must tolerate duplicate messages because delivery is at-least-once.
schema-registry-enforced
Every Kafka topic has an enforced schema; unregistered payloads are rejected.
cron-in-airflow
Scheduled jobs run in Airflow, not in application cron.
nightly-recon-at-2am
The reconciliation job runs at two in the morning and must finish before six.
email-via-ses
Transactional email goes through SES; marketing email uses a separate provider.
sms-has-three-variables
The SMS template system supports at most three substitution variables.
mobile-app-min-version
The mobile app enforces a minimum supported version and blocks older clients.
frontend-is-nextjs
The storefront is a Next.js application rendered on the server.
design-tokens-shared
Design tokens are published as a package and shared between web and mobile.
a11y-target-wcag-aa
Accessibility target is WCAG 2.2 level AA for all customer facing pages.
tests-need-80-percent
Pull requests are blocked below eighty percent line coverage on changed files.
e2e-runs-nightly
End to end tests run nightly, not on every pull request, because they take forty minutes.
flaky-tests-quarantined
Flaky tests are quarantined rather than deleted, and reviewed every sprint.
no-direct-prod-db-writes
Nobody writes to the production database directly; all changes go through migrations.
oncall-rotation-weekly
The on call rotation changes every Monday at ten in the morning.
sev1-needs-postmortem
Any severity one incident requires a written postmortem within five working days.
error-budget-is-99-9
The service level objective is ninety nine point nine percent monthly availability.
canary-is-five-percent
Canary releases start at five percent of traffic for thirty minutes.
rollback-must-be-one-command
Any deployment must be reversible with a single command.
